stories.title: Tehran hints at Hormuz talks with US as leaders gather at UN
stories.summary: Iran signalled openness to dialogue with Washington over the Strait of Hormuz as world leaders gathered at the UN, according to Reuters. Any talks could ease tensions over the critical oil shipping lane.

stories.title: Cargo ship crashes into fishing boat near Singapore
stories.summary: Verified footage appears to show a cargo ship colliding with a fishing boat near Singapore, with investigators still working to establish when and how the crash happened.

stories.title: Trump and Xi meet as tensions flare over AI, trade and Iran
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump and China's Xi Jinping are meeting to try to manage rising tensions over AI competition, trade and Iran while both seek stability. The AI race is a flashpoint that could strain any cooperation.

stories.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna, touting lower cost and fewer mistakes
stories.summary: OpenAI expanded its GPT-6 generation with updated Sol and Luna models it says are more efficient and handle tasks better than Anthropic's top models. The release came about 90 minutes after Anthropic unveiled Opus 5.5, underscoring the fierce frontier-model rivalry.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Opus 5.5 with lower prices and Fable-level performance
stories.summary: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 sets a new state of the art in coding and knowledge work at lower prices, according to the company. It is the second Opus update in about two months, and Anthropic says it is building infrastructure to support demand.

stories.title: Quinshon Judkins not worried about the Browns' run game yet
stories.summary: Browns running back Quinshon Judkins downplayed concerns about the struggling ground game, saying the unit is still building familiarity together. Through two games Cleveland's leading rusher is Deshaun Watson with 60 yards and the team averages 2.9 yards per carry.

stories.title: Ryan Day challenges Julian Sayin before Big Ten opener vs Illinois
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day is pushing quarterback Julian Sayin for more consistency and a wider spread of targets ahead of Saturday's Big Ten opener against Illinois. Sayin has passed for 839 yards and six touchdowns, but nearly a third of his attempts have gone to Jeremiah Smith.

stories.title: 5 storylines ahead of the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix
stories.summary: Formula 1 previews five storylines for this weekend's Azerbaijan Grand Prix in Baku, including a possible return for Red Bull's Isack Hadjar and a bumper Formula 2 supporting round. Red Bull says it will not rush Hadjar's recovery.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov dev explains launch of a publishing house
stories.summary: Battlestate Games founder Nikita Buyanov explained why the studio opened a publishing house to back riskier projects, per ixbt.games. The move signals the developer is extending beyond Escape from Tarkov.

stories.title: Anduril to build more drones near Columbus
stories.summary: Anduril's $1 billion Pickaway County plant near Columbus will begin producing the ALTIUS 600 autonomous drone as a fourth product line. The expansion adds output at the Arsenal-1 site near Rickenbacker Airport.

stories.title: Two men arrested after shootout with Columbus police that injured bystanders
stories.summary: Two men were arrested after an August shooting north of Downtown in which Columbus police returned fire and two bystanders were injured, NBC4 reported. The suspects are now facing charges in the case.
